stem: Why does the narrator use a metaphor to describe his response to playing the piano?
instruction:
Read this quotation from paragraph 17 of the excerpt from The Piano Shop on the Left Bank.

I thought, this is a kind of love; and, as in love, my senses amplified and enhanced the love object, all with an insouciance and willing enthusiasm.

options.label: A
options.text: To explain how he is able to remember a piece of music

options.label: B
options.text: To show how sharing music increases enjoyment

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that owning a piano can spark enthusiasm

options.label: D
options.text: To reveal the depth of his feelings towards the piano

visual_elements: I thought, this is a kind of love; and, as in love, my senses amplified and enhanced the love object, all with an insouciance and willing enthusiasm.
